text:
If you're heading out for the last light, keep the rain jacket handy: sunset is at 7:33, and the sky stays cloudy with a chance of showers or a rumble of thunder through about 11. Showers should taper off by midnight, with a low near 56, and the lake turns from south to north at 5 to 15 knots, though waves stay at a foot or less. It’s a damp evening, but not a rough one on the water.

Monday looks like the better half of the next 24 hours, partly sunny with a high around 78 and light northwest winds. The forecasters call the daytime dry, though the European model keeps a shower chance alive, so I’d still carry a light layer if your plans run late. Another shower chance arrives after 10 tomorrow night. Good evening plans are fine, but wrap up waterfront time before the showers become more likely.

week.blurb: Showers keep today cool near 70, with a few rumbles possible tonight.

Rain likely, with a high near 77, and thunderstorms possible into Tuesday night.
A stormy, mostly cloudy day near 78, with showers and thunderstorms lingering into Wednesday night.
Plan around a wet Thursday, with showers likely through the day and night near 78.
Friday trends brighter near 77, though scattered showers and thunderstorms remain possible afternoon into night.
Partly sunny Saturday near 76, with a chance of showers and thunderstorms through the day and early evening.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): Monday will be a pleasant day with partly sunny skies and highs in the 70s. Lows will be in the 50s. Computer models go back and forth with Tuesday. Showers are likely, though most of it (once again) now looks to remain to our southwest. Highs will be in the upper 60s to low 70s. Wednesday will continue the chance for scattered showers. A stronger storm system could bring rain with occasional heavy downpours on Thursday. Flooding isn’t expected, but we’ll keep an eye on it. Though the middle of the week won’t have the best conditions for the Champlain Valley Fair, this will provide the region with a beneficial rain as it’s been rather dry lately.
